message: NO_TRADE: complete fresh 18-symbol Dukascopy H1 BID/ASK scan GDESK-2026-09-25T04-b4dfba0c93 found no genuinely qualified setup. JPY strength remains broad across USDJPY, AUDJPY, CADJPY, CHFJPY, GBPJPY and EURJPY, but the latest completed H1 bars are already extended into fresh lows and the signals are highly correlated, making a new entry a chase rather than clean asymmetry. USDCHF has upward momentum but is near a fresh local high without a clean pullback trigger. EURUSD, GBPUSD, AUDUSD and NZDUSD remain weak/mixed; the remaining crosses lack a sufficiently clean independent trigger. XAUUSD reversed lower after the Asian rebound and remains too volatile for a clean 0.25%-0.5% risk entry from the supplied completed bars. No trade is preferable to forcing correlated or late momentum exposure.
